purpose: Normative target logical dependency graph, not a scan of current imports or an executable boundary-checker configuration.
sourceMapping: MOD-01 must produce exact file ownership; MOD-02 must implement and test the checker. No current source file is exempt merely because mapping is pending.
edgeSemantics: caller -> dependency; type-only imports, re-exports and injected semantic dependencies count; listed platform edges permit only layer-scoped capabilities, never arbitrary database access.

modules.owns: Identifiers, domain values, error vocabulary, trusted execution context value types; no application services.

Deterministic calculations and legal effects with explicit time/seed.

Db/UoW, clock, config, logger, cancellation, bounded generic delivery mechanics; no named gameplay cases.

Topology, instance identity, scoped resources, runtime progress and epoch; not NPC orchestration.

Named cross-domain commands, sync preparation, world scheduling and post-commit coordination; no direct ORM or numeric rules.
HTTP validation, context/auth adaptation, DTO conversion, error mapping; no database capability.
